title: Epimorphic representatives for one related filtered differential
statement: Let C be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], K an integer-indexed cochain complex and F a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration]. Let r be any integer and i,j integer bidegrees with j=i+(r,1-r). Use the concrete graded cycles Z_r [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. There exist an object A, maps t:A→F^(i.1)K^(i.1+i.2), tprime:A→F^(j.1)K^(j.1+j.2), x:A→Z_r^i and y:A→Z_r^j such that x is epic, dt=tprime in K, and x,y composed with their graded-cycle inclusions equal the respective graded projections of t,tprime. There is no positive-r assumption.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed cycle, boundary and differential formulas and lemma-spectral-sequence-filtered-complex

proof.text: For a mono f and a subobject P≤mk(f), map_f(pullback_f(P))=P: the counit gives one inequality; factoring P.arrow through f and then its pullback gives the other. For g on the source of f, R,S≤mk(f) with the restriction of g to pullback_f(S) zero, set T=exists_g(pullback_f(R)). The adjunction unit puts R inside map_f(pullback_g(T)); the zero restriction does the same for S. Hence their supremum also lies there, and pulling back along f and using the exists/pullback adjunction gives exists_g(pullback_f(R∨S))=T. The converse inequality is monotonicity.

Take f to be the degreewise F^p inclusion, g its graded quotient, R=F^p∩d-inverse(F^(p+r)), and S=F^(p+1). The inclusion F^(p+1)→F^p followed by g is zero by the cokernel condition, so the preceding image identity identifies Z_r with exists_g(pullback_f(R)). Let A be this pullback R and t its arrow. Factor t followed by d through the target filtration inclusion by the defining pullback. The target degree is n+1 by relatedness. This gives tprime. Form x by the image factorThruImage and the two specified image/subobject isomorphisms; it is epic and has the required projection equation.

The derivative of tprime is zero by K.d_comp_d. Its ambient image therefore factors through the target cycle representative intersection and its sum with the next filtration step. Pull back to the target filtration step and take the graded image factorization, giving y and its projection equation. Assemble the four maps and the epic instance. The construction works at every integer r, including zero and negative r.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredComplex_differential_representatives_cover
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) (r : ℤ)
    (i j : ℤ × ℤ) (hij : (ComplexShape.up' (r, 1 - r)).Rel i j) :
    ∃ (A : C)
      (t : A ⟶ (F.step i.1 : CochainComplex C ℤ).X (i.1 + i.2))
      (t' : A ⟶ (F.step j.1 : CochainComplex C ℤ).X (j.1 + j.2))
      (x : A ⟶ (F.complexCycles i.1 (i.1 + i.2) r : C))
      (y : A ⟶ (F.complexCycles j.1 (j.1 + j.2) r : C)),
      Epi x ∧
      t ≫ (F.step i.1).arrow.f (i.1 + i.2) ≫ K.d (i.1 + i.2) (j.1 + j.2) =
        t' ≫ (F.step j.1).arrow.f (j.1 + j.2) ∧
      x ≫ (F.complexCycles i.1 (i.1 + i.2) r).arrow =
        t ≫ (F.complexQuotientπ i.1 (i.1 + 1) (by omega)).f (i.1 + i.2) ∧
      y ≫ (F.complexCycles j.1 (j.1 + j.2) r).arrow =
        t' ≫ (F.complexQuotientπ j.1 (j.1 + 1) (by omega)).f (j.1 + j.2)
